extension.description: Build Delphi Win32 and Win64 projects with DCC32 and DCC64 from Visual Studio Code.
configuration.language.description: Language used by the Delphi DCC Builder interface and extension Settings page. The built-in VS Code Settings view follows the VS Code display language.
configuration.version.description: Delphi compiler version used to resolve version-specific build settings and BDS environment values.
configuration.resourceBuild.description: Prepare missing project resources and compile .dproj RcCompile resources before running DCC.
configuration.compilerPath.description: Required absolute path to the Delphi XE7 DCC32.exe. Builds fail when this setting is empty.
configuration.compiler64Path.description: Optional absolute path to the Delphi XE7 DCC64.exe. The Win64 Explorer build command is shown when this setting is not empty.
configuration.rsvarsPath.description: Optional absolute path to rsvars.bat. Leave empty to discover it from the configured compiler or BDS installation.
configuration.brcc32Path.description: Optional absolute path to BRCC32.exe used to compile RcCompile resources. Leave empty to discover it from the Delphi installation or PATH.
configuration.showBuildPlanMenu.descript: Show or hide the Show Build Plan command in the .dproj Explorer context menu.
configuration.outputPathHistoryLimit.des: Maximum number of output path history entries stored for each .dproj project.
configuration.outputEncoding.description: Encoding used to decode DCC32 or DCC64 output.
configuration.additionalArguments.descri: Additional DCC arguments appended before the main source file.
configuration.environment.description: Environment variables applied to DCC32 or DCC64 after the selected Delphi version's registry environment.
